title: Segmentation Bases — Overview
summary: The four classic bases for dividing consumer markets: who they are, where they are, how they live, and how they buy.
body:
The four classic bases for dividing consumer markets: who they are, where they are, how they live, and how they buy. Standard marketing theory.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include STP Marketing, Personas, Targeting Strategies.
